name: How much does it cost to repair water damage from a ceiling leak?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to repair water damage from a ceiling leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair water damage from a ceiling leak varies widely depending on the leak's duration, the extent of the damage, and the materials affected. Factors include the need for water extraction, drying equipment, mold remediation, and structural repairs. A professional assessment is required to provide an accurate estimate, as costs can range from minor repairs to extensive reconstruction.
